interpretation.mechanism_limit: The 31-to-32 carry switches five low bits off and one MSB on per leg. Code-dependent effective TG loading and r3 input interaction are plausible. Symmetric endpoints and matched wiring do not prove the carry mechanism or exclude orientation-dependent intermediate behavior.
interpretation.missing_mirror_diagnostic: Measure k=31,47,15 with both drive directions to pair against k=32,16,48. Compare antisymmetric (d(k)-d(63-k))/2 and orientation-even (d(k)+d(63-k))/2 with per-leg complex swaps.
interpretation.not_measured: No full 64-code DNL/INL, isolated mechanism, transistor nonideal transient, payload SER, post-layout, or compensator approval follows from AC60.
interpretation.separate_ablations: At fixed source impedance compare exact native TG vs controlled ideal switch with the same connected r3; independently compare loaded r3 vs the same declared symmetric substitute load while keeping each switch implementation fixed. Extract r3 input complex two-port admittance, not a guessed single capacitance.
interpretation.verified_mapping: P=32 selects only bit 5 (40fF/section). N=31 selects bits 0-4 (38.75fF/section). Gates are complementary, all 24 native TG pairs per leg present, and P/N device parameter tails exactly match.
interpretation.what_data_support: Broadband differential delay varies strongly with frequency, sparse d56 samples are nonmonotone, endpoint P/N swap can be quantified independently, and source termination changes diagonal gain, mode conversion and noise.

method.compact_limit: Exact runner/deck hashes and actual parent diffs checked. The compact archive omits full runtime benches and raw PSF bytes.
method.endpoint_symmetry: Compare full H(0) against J H(63) J at identical frequency and source impedance; J exchanges P/N.
method.group_delay: Finite differences of unwrapped phase; dense and eight-probe results reported separately.
method.noise: Saved P-driven stationary X_ip-X_im RMS integrated over 1MHz-56GHz, with r3 connected; no sampled noise or BER claim.
method.phase_delay: Unwrap diagonal trim-leg phases independently and compute -phase/(2*pi*f); d=P-N. This is phase delay, not group delay.
method.sparse_interpolation: Complex linear interpolation in log frequency, as original summary.
